blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated animal re-identification from photograph sequences can facilitate minimally invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture studies at scale. Yet, photographs taken during an observation session can vary greatly in quality, not always providing the necessary information for accurate re-identification. In this paper, we present new methods for taxonomic classification, sex determination, and open-set re-identification from image sequences. We train and evaluate our models on a dataset of 35,914 photographs of 474 individual seahorses observed in the wild. We demonstrate that our approach, by combining information from multiple photographs, yields state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 从相片序列中自动对动物进行重新识别,可以促进规模最小的入侵性捕获-Mark-Capture研究. 然而,在观测过程中拍摄的照片在质量上可能有很大差异,并不总是为准确的重新识别提供必要的信息。 在本文中,我们提出了分类分类分类,性别确定,以及从图像序列中开放设置再识别的新方法. 在野外观测到的474个个体海马的35 914相相片的数据集上,我们训练和评估我们的模型。 我们表明,通过结合多张照片中的信息,我们的做法产生了最先进的性能。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 1.1 Animal re-identification from photographs
blocks.zh: 1.1 从照片中重新识别动物

blocks.en:
Animal re-identification involves assigning an identity to an individual based on distinctive characteristics such as body patterns or other morphological traits. Animal re-identification from photographs taken in the wild has emerged as a powerful non-invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture (CMR) tool with several practical advantages over artificial markers ( Glennie et al., 2021 ) , including reduced costs, reduced harm or stress, potential for public participation in photo-based CMR programs ( Gould et al., 2023 ) , and large-scale use of camera traps ( Schneider et al., 2019 ; Alexander and Craighead, 2022 ) .
However, manual photo cataloging by experts is time-consuming and hinders its large-scale deployment ( Connor, 2001 ; Irvine et al., 1982 ) . Therefore, automated animal re-identification through computer vision has emerged as a promising solution ( Bolger et al., 2012 ; Schneider et al., 2019 ; Renò et al., 2019 ) .
In particular, recent advances in deep learning have shown that models can achieve high performance in re-identifying individuals across various species ( Vidal et al., 2021 ; Beyan et al., 2026 ) , sometimes exceeding human observer capability ( Schneider et al., 2020 ) . In practice, during a single encounter with an animal, an observer or a camera trap will typically capture a sequence of photographs, which may provide different viewing angles, distances, or lighting, and together can provide more information about the animal’s identity than photographs taken in isolation. In this work, we develop methods for automated taxonomic classification, sex determination, and animal re-identification from camera sequences, leveraging the complementary information from multiple photographs while accounting for the variable informativeness of different photographs in a sequence relative to the animal characteristics and identity.
We apply this approach to an expert-curated dataset of seahorses from two species, the long-snouted seahorse ( Hippocampus guttulatus ) and the short-snouted seahorse ( Hippocampus hippocampus ) from the Thau lagoon, on the French Mediterranean coast. This unpublished dataset contains expert-reidentified sequences of underwater photographs of seahorses in the wild.

动物的再识别涉及根据身体形态或其他形态特征等显著特征赋予个人身份. 从野外取出的照片中重新识别出动物,已经成为一种强大的非侵入性捕获-Mark-Capture(CMR)工具,与人工标记相比具有若干实际优势(Glennie等,2021年),包括成本降低,伤害或压力降低,公众参与以相片为基础的CMR方案的可能性(Gould等,2023年),以及大规模使用相机陷阱(Schneider等,2019年;Alexander和Craighead等,2022年).

blocks.en: 1.2 Re-identification methods for seahorses
blocks.zh: 1.2 海马的再识别方法

blocks.en:
Seahorse populations are experiencing a marked decline worldwide, which may be linked to fishing pressure due to illegal trade, habitat loss and warming waters ( Harasti, 2016 ; Pierri et al., 2021 ; Correia, 2022 ; Vivas et al., 2024 ) . The last global assessment of seahorses, conducted in 2016 by Project Seahorse with the International Union for Conservation of Nature Species Survival Commission Seahorse, Pipefish and Seadragon Specialist Group, established that at least one-third of the 42 species then recognized were threatened.
Specifically, Mediterranean Hippocampus guttulatus and Hippocampus hippocampus populations showed sharp density declines ( Caldwell and Vincent, 2012b ; Pierri et al., 2021 ; Correia, 2022 ; Vivas et al., 2024 ) .
However, the population dynamics of many seahorse species remain poorly understood. Project Seahorse highlights that 17 seahorse species are data-deficient, so that their conservation status could not be assessed. Reliably estimating seahorse demographic parameters remains difficult due to the limitations of traditional CMR or transect methods which are complex to implement for these cryptic, low-density fish with camouflage behavior ( Curtis and Vincent, 2006 ) .
The most common artificial tagging method in seahorses is the application of visible implant fluorescent elastomer (VIFE) tags, which involves injecting seahorses with long-lasting colorants, allowing for individual recognition upon recapture ( Woods and Martin-Smith, 2004 ; Monteiro et al., 2005 ; Curtis, 2006 ; Sogabe et al., 2007 ; Harasti, 2021 ) . However, they require trained professionals and do not readily scale to citizen-science programs.

特别是地中海 Hippocampus gutulatus和Hippocampus的人口密度急剧下降(Caldwell和Vincent,2012b;Pierri等,2021;Correia,2022;Vivas等,2024)。
然而,许多海马物种的人口动态仍然不甚了解。 海马项目强调,17个海马物种缺乏数据,因此无法评估其保护状况。 由于传统的CMR或截面方法的局限性,很难可靠地估计出海马的人口参数。 对这些隐秘而密度低并带有伪装行为的鱼类来说,这些方法十分复杂(Curtis和Vincent,2006年)。
在海马中最常见的人工标记方法是应用明显的植入荧光弹性体(VIFE)标记,这种标记涉及用长效色素来注射海马,允许个人在回收时得到承认(Woods和Martin-Smith,2004年;Monteiro等,2005年;Curtis,2006年;Sogabe等,2007年;Harasti,2021年)。 但是,它们需要训练有素的专业人员,不能轻易扩大公民科学方案的范围。

blocks.en: 1.3 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.3 缴款

blocks.en: In this paper, we present the following contributions. First, we develop multi-view seahorse taxonomic classification and sex determination models that leverage multiple photographs of a single seahorse observation to outperform approaches based on single images. Second, we present a new method for animal re-identification that: • Uses a Bayes-optimal decision rule for open-set re-identification. • Combines a fine-tuned foundation model trained on large multi-species corpora for the extraction of global descriptors, coupled with a local pattern matching module. • Leverages an arbitrary number of photographs to enable reliable animal re-identification, weighting their relevance based on estimated image informativeness. We demonstrate that this approach yields high performance in seahorse re-identification.
blocks.zh: 在本文件中,我们提出以下意见。 首先,我们开发了多景海马分类和性别测定模型,这些模型利用了单一海马观测的多幅相片,从而超越了基于单一图像的方法。 第二,我们提出了一种新的动物重新识别方法,即: 使用Bayes-优化决定规则进行开放式的重新识别。 · 结合一个经过精细调整的基础模型,对大多物种公司进行培训,以提取全球描述符,同时结合一个本地模式匹配模块。 • 任意取出数量多的照片,以便能够对动物进行可靠的重新识别,根据图像信息估计来衡量其相关性。 我们表明,这种做法在海马重新识别方面表现良好。

blocks.en: 1.4 Related work
blocks.zh: 1.4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Modern photo re-ID techniques based on deep learning can be broadly categorized into two approaches.
The first one relies on deep neural networks trained to produce image embeddings (also called global embeddings), the second relies on the extraction and matching of local features.
The global features approach is typically framed as a metric learning problem. A deep neural network is trained to minimize a triplet loss or an ArcFace loss ( Deng et al., 2019 ) . At inference time, the cosine similarity between the embeddings of each query image and gallery image is computed, and a similarity threshold is used to decide whether the image belongs to an individual already observed or not. In the former case, a ranked list of candidate matches is produced.
Recently, foundation models trained on many datasets from different species have shown strong performance in re-identification, both in zero-shot learning and after fine-tuning on a specific dataset ( Čermák et al., 2024 ; Otarashvili et al., 2024 ) .
Local features are extracted by deep neural networks such as ALIKED ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , DISK ( Tyszkiewicz et al., 2020 ) or SuperPoint ( DeTone et al., 2018 ) and are matched using a deep neural network specialized for feature matching, LightGlue ( Lindenberger et al., 2023 ) . This approach is usually more accurate than global feature matching, but since it performs pairwise comparison between the query and the gallery images, it becomes computationally impractical as the dataset grows.
In order to get the most out of the slow but accurate local features approach and the fast but less accurate global features, Adam et al. (2025c) introduced WildFusion, which uses global feature similarity to create a list of the most likely matching candidates from the gallery, on which local feature matching is applied. The scores are then calibrated using isotonic regression and combined using a weighted average. Yesharim et al. (2026) used a related approach to achieve very high re-ID performance on the Hula painted frog. They noticed that the local feature extractor ALIKED, combined with the LightGlue matcher, led to near-perfect closed-set retrieval performance. However, it is computationally expensive. Therefore, they first fine-tuned the MiewID foundation model ( Otarashvili et al., 2024 ) on their dataset, and used the resulting cosine similarities to shortlist the most likely matches, then applied ALIKED/LightGlue on the shortlist to produce a final ranking.
blocks.zh:
基于深入学习的现代相片再识别技术可被广泛分为两种方法.
第一种依赖于训练有素的深层神经网络来产生图像嵌入(也叫全球嵌入),第二种依赖于取出和匹配本地特征.
全球特征方法通常被视为一个衡量学习问题。 深层神经网络被训练出将三重损失或ArcFace损失最小化(Deng等,2019年). 推论时,计算出每个查询图像和相册图像的嵌入相间的同位素相似性,并使用相像阈值来决定图像是否属于已经观察到的个体. 在前一种情况下,会制作一份排名排行榜的候选赛事.
最近,接受过不同物种许多数据集培训的基础模型在重新识别方面表现出了很强的性能,无论是在零射入学习方面还是在对特定数据集进行微调后(Čermák等,2024;Otarashvili等,2024.).
本地地物由深神经网络提取出,如ALIKED(赵等,2023年),DISK(Tyszkiewicz等,2020年)或SuperPoint(DeTone等,2018年)等,并使用特有地物匹配的深神经网络进行配对,LightGlue(Lindenberger等,2023年). 这种方法通常比全局特征匹配更准确,但由于它进行查询和图片库图像的对等比较,随着数据集的增长,这种方法在计算上变得不切实际.
为了从慢而准确的局部地物方法以及快而不太准确的全球地物方法中获取出最多的,亚当等 (2025年c)引入了"荒野融合"(WildFusion),它利用全球地物的相似性来创建出一个来自画廊中最有可能匹配的候选者的名单,其中应用了局部地物相配. 然后用同位素回归法对分数进行校正,并用加权平均值进行合并。 Yesharim等 (2026年) 使用相干的方法,在Hula所绘青蛙上实现了极高的再ID性能. 他们注意到,当地地物提取器ALIKED,与"光格卢"相匹配器结合,导致了近乎完美的闭塞取回性能. 然而,计算费用却很高。 因此,他们首先在数据集上微调了MiewID的基础模型(Otarashvili等,2024年),并利用由此产生的同心素相似性将最可能匹配的选入短名单,然后在短名单上应用ALIKED/LightGlue来进行最终排名.

blocks.en: H. guttulatus and H. hippocampus can be distinguished based on head, snout, and trunk shape ( Lourie et al., 2004 ) . Hippocampus guttulatus has a distinct mark pattern composed of white spots scattered throughout the entire body surface, allowing for photo-identification by human experts with manual labeling of spots and image comparisons ( Correia et al., 2014 ) . Moreover, Correia et al. (2021) demonstrated that it is possible to re-identify H. hippocampus from photographs taken in captivity based on crown characteristics.
blocks.zh: H. gutulatus和H. Hippocampus可以根据头部、鼻部和树干形状加以区分(Lourie等,2004年)。 Hippocampus gutulatus有一个独特的标记图案,由遍布整个身体表面的白色斑点组成,允许人类专家用人工标记斑点并进行图像比较来进行相片识别(Correia等,2014年)。 此外,Correia等人(2021年)表明,根据王冠特征从囚禁中拍摄的照片中重新识别H. Hippocampus是可能的。

blocks.en:
Spoto et al. (2024) developed two models for taxonomic classification of H. hippocampus and H. guttulatus on a dataset of seahorse photographs from the Mar Piccolo of Taranto, at the northern end of the Gulf of Taranto (Ionian Sea). Their dataset contained 2227 images of H. guttulatus and 1667 images of H. hippocampus . They found that a VGG16 architecture achieved an AUPRC (Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve) of about 0.97.
However, despite the dataset containing multiple images of the same individuals, sometimes extracted from a video which likely creates near-duplicate images of the same individual, the authors do not mention any data leakage mitigation strategy. They reported a standard 5-fold cross-validation approach, which implies that photographs from the same individual, and even the same image sequence, may be present in both the training and test sets. The reported performance may therefore be inflated.
blocks.zh:
Spoto等人(2024年)在塔兰托湾(爱奥尼亚海)北端的马皮克洛出海马照片数据集上,开发了H. hippocampus和H. gutulatus两种分类学分类模型. 他们的数据集包含了2227幅H.gutulatus的相片和1667幅H.hippocampus的相片. 他们发现VGG16架构实现了约0.97的AUPRC(精确-召回曲线下的地区).
然而,尽管数据集包含同一个人的多幅相片,有时是从一段可能制造同一个人近似重复相片的相片中取出,但作者并未提及任何数据泄漏减缓策略. 他们报告了一种标准的5倍交叉验证方法,这意味着来自同一个人甚至同一图像序列的照片可能出现在培训和测试集中。 因此,所报告的业绩可能会被夸大。

blocks.en: Aloui and Renoult (2022) reported promising preliminary results in the automated re-identification of Hippocampus guttulatus using a dataset related to ours. They trained EfficientNet variants ( Tan and Le, 2020 ) using triplet loss ( Schroff et al., 2015 ) . However, they only evaluated their approach in a closed-set setting, where the query images correspond to individuals always present in the gallery. In this setting, they reported top-1 accuracy of up to 76% on manually curated images where the head is clearly visible.
blocks.zh: Aloui和Renoult(2022年)报告说,在使用与我们有关的数据集自动重新确定Hippocampus gutulatus方面,初步结果很有希望。 他们利用三重损失(Schroff等人,2015年)培训了高效网络变体(Tan和Le,2020年)。 然而,他们只在封闭的设置中评价了自己的方法,其中查询图像与画廊中总是出现的个人相对应. 在此情况下,他们报告说,在手动剪辑的图像上,头部明显可见,其最高一等精度可达76%.

blocks.en: Bergamini et al. (2018) proposed a multi-view re-identification method for cattle re-identification, which uses a front and a side image of the head which are fed to two different networks. The resulting embeddings are then combined and fed to another network that fuses the representations. However, this hybrid fusion approach does not accomodate more than two images, and requires manual annotation of front and side images.
blocks.zh: Bergamini等人(2018年)提出了牛再识别的多视图再识别方法,它使用头部的正面和侧面图像,这些图像被输入两个不同的网络. 由此产生的嵌入物随后被合并,并被输入另一网络,以熔接表达物。 然而,这种混合聚变方法不会使两个以上的图像相通,需要手动对前相和侧相进行注释.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Data
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据

blocks.en: Photographs from H. hippocampus and H. guttulatus were taken underwater by marine biologists between March 2022 and October 2025. Species, sex and identity were determined by SL. The dataset contains photographs of 461 H. guttulatus and 13 H. hippocampus individuals (see Table 1 ). The median time between consecutive observations of the same individual was 13 days for H. guttulatus and 7 days for H. hippocampus (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 照片来自 H. Hipopocampus和H. gutulatus被海洋生物学家从2022年3月至2025年10月在水下取走. 物种,性别和身份由SL确定. 数据集包含461 H. gutulatus和13 H. hippocampus个人的照片(见表1)。 H. gutulatus连续观察同一人之间的中间时间为13天,H. hippocampus为7天(表2)。

blocks.en:
The data were not specifically collected for training machine learning models, and therefore reflect standard field experiment conditions, where the seahorse photographs were taken from different distances, viewing angles, lighting conditions, and backgrounds. Photographs attempted to capture both fine-grained details of the head and the overall environment. Some photographs also contain juvenile individuals. We did not manually curate the data to better capture the performance of the models in a field deployment setting, in contexts such as citizen science programs.
Moreover, the extreme class imbalance (98% of observations correspond to H. guttulatus ) reflects natural species observation imbalance.
blocks.zh:
这些数据不是专门为培训机器学习模型而收集的,因此反映了标准实地实验条件,即从不同距离、取景角度、照明条件和背景拍摄出海马照片。 照片试图捕捉头部和整个环境的精细细节。 一些照片中还包含青少年个人. 我们没有手动整理数据,以更好地记录模型在诸如公民科学方案等情况下在实地部署环境中的表现。
此外,极端类失衡(98%的观测结果与H. gutulatus相对应)反映了自然物种观测失衡.

blocks.en: 2.2 Image preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 图像预处理

blocks.en: Seahorses were detected and segmented in images using the Segment Anything Model 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) , which requires no manual annotation of the data (prompt: "seahorse", threshold value of 0.7 for detection, and 0.6 for the segmentation mask confidence). Crops corresponded to detection boxes with a 5% padding. The segmentation masks were used to set the background to white. The cropped and segmented images were white-padded to be square and resized to the models’ input dimensions.
blocks.zh: 海马在图像中被检测出并分出使用分块"Anything Model 3(Carion等,2025年)",这不需要人工注释数据(即:"海马",检测阈值为0.7,分块口罩置信度为0.6). 作物对应的检测箱有5%的垫. 分化口罩被用来将背景设定为白色. 所收割和分解的图像是白色加成正方形并调整到模型的输入维度。

blocks.en: 2.3 Data splits for species and sex classification
blocks.zh: 2.3 物种和性别分类数据划分

blocks.en: To evaluate taxonomic classification and sex determination models, we used a stratified 5-fold cross-validation approach. To make sure that images of an individual are not present in both the training, validation, and test sets, stratification was performed at the individual level, balancing class proportions across folds by individual count. Evaluation metrics were computed on pooled out-of-fold predictions, that is, predictions from all folds are aggregated into a single score.
blocks.zh: 为了评价分类分类和性别测定模型,我们采用了分级的5倍交叉验证方法. 为确保培训、验证和测试组合中不出现个人图像,在个人一级进行了分层,以个人计数平衡不同折叠的班级比例。 评价衡量标准是根据集合外的预测计算的,即所有折叠的预测汇总成一个分数。

blocks.en: Hyperparameters were tuned on a held-out calibration split nested within each of the 5 cross-validation folds. Concretely, we split the training observations in each fold into an 80% core part and a 20% held-out part, and the identity-balanced accuracy was evaluated on the held-out part. The selected hyperparameters were then used to refit the full training fold.
blocks.zh: 超参数被调用在5个交叉验证折叠内每个被搁置的分出校正上. 具体地说,我们把每个组合的训练观察分为80%的核心部分和20%的搁置部分,对搁置部分的特性平衡准确性进行了评估。 之后使用所选的超参数来修复整个训练折叠.

blocks.en:
In our experiments, we evaluated image-level classification performance, average logits fusion, and logit-sum fusion. Additionally, we also considered majority vote, in which each image in an observation votes for a class label, and the class probability is the fraction of images voting for that class. Therefore, observation-level prediction corresponds to the class with the most votes.
For sex classification, we excluded the 63 individuals of unknown sex.
blocks.zh:
在我们的实验中,我们评估了图像级的分类性能, 平均对数聚变, 和对数和聚变。 此外,我们还考虑了多数投票,其中观察中的每个图像都投票给一个类标签,而类概率是该类图像投票的分数. 因此,观测水平的预测与得票最多的类相对应.
就性别分类而言,我们排除了63个性别不明的人。

blocks.en: Given the extreme species imbalance in our dataset and the small effective sample size, we decided to focus our investigation on linear probing of vision foundation models.
blocks.zh: 鉴于我们数据集中的极端物种不平衡,而且有效的样本规模很小,我们决定集中调查视觉基础模型的线性探测。

blocks.en:
Therefore, for image-level taxonomic and sex classification, we trained logistic regression models on the embeddings obtained from two different vision foundation models: either BioCLIP 2.5 ( Gu et al., 2025 ) or DINOv3 ViT-L/16 CLS ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) .
Images fed to BioCLIP 2.5 were normalized using OpenAI CLIP statistics, whereas images fed to DINOv3 were normalized using ImageNet statistics.
We applied L2 regularization and tuned the inverse regularization strength coefficient using a grid search over 25 log-spaced values in [0.01, 10].
blocks.zh:
因此,在图像一级分类和性别分类方面,我们对从两个不同的视觉基础模型中获得的嵌入式后勤回归模型进行了培训: BioCLIP 2.5(Gu等人,2025年)或DINOv3 ViT-L/16 CLS (Siméoni等人,2025年).
图像输入到 BioCLIP 2.5通过OpenAI CLIP统计实现正常化,而提供给DINOv3的图像则通过ImageNet统计实现正常化。
我们应用了L2规范化,并用[0.01,10]中25个对数的网格搜索调整了逆规范化强度系数。

blocks.en:
DINOv3 is a vision foundation model trained using self-supervision on a curated set of 1,689 million images. By contrast, BioCLIP is a variant of CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) further pre-trained on TreeOfLife-10M, a large and diverse dataset of biology images, using a hierarchical variant of contrastive learning specifically designed to enable high performance in taxonomic classification ( Stevens et al., 2024 ) .
BioCLIP 2 is a scaled version trained on the larger and more diverse TreeOfLife-200M dataset, with a larger vision transformer (ViT-L/14 pre-trained on LAION-2B). We used the BioCLIP 2.5 variant, which uses the larger ViT-H/14 backbone and was trained on an updated version of TreeOfLife-200M that adds 19 million more images to the original version. For both models, images were resized to 224×224 pixels.
blocks.zh:
DINOv3是一个视觉基础模型,在16.89亿个被整理的图像集上,使用自监视器训练. 相形之下,BioCLIP是CLIP的一个变体(Radford等,2021年)在TreeOfLife-10M上进一步预训,这是生物影像的大型而多样的数据集,它使用一个等级化的对比性学习变体,专门设计,使分类学的性能高活(Stevens等,2024年).

blocks.en: 2.5.3 Data splits for re-identification
blocks.zh: 2.5.3 用于重新识别的数据分割

blocks.en: For re-identification, given the computational cost of CNN fine-tuning, we used a single identity-disjoint split (70% train / 10% val / 20% test). Identities were stratified by their number of observations so that each split receives a comparable mix of sparse and well-sampled individuals.
blocks.zh: 在重新识别时,考虑到CNN微调的计算成本,我们使用一个单一的身份-分裂分(70%的列车/10%的val/20%的测试). 特征按观察次数进行分层,使每一分块都得到人数稀少和抽样良好的个人的类似组合。

blocks.en:
Within the validation and test sets, an observation can be either in the query or in the gallery. More precisely, it can have four distinct roles: known query (an observation among the query batch, corresponding to an individual in the gallery), unknown query, gallery-only distractor (an observation corresponding to an individual not present in the query batch), and gallery member (observations in the gallery from individuals that are also represented in the query).
Therefore, we perform an additional five-fold role rotation, corresponding to an additional identity-level split within the validation and test sets. Again, these splits are stratified by observation count. In each fold, observations corresponding to a given identity can either correspond to an unknown query, a known query (therefore also in the gallery), or a distractor in the gallery. Within each fold, identities with only a single observation are excluded from the known query role and remain in the gallery as distractors.
blocks.zh:
在验证和测试集内,观察既可以在查询中,也可以在画廊中. 更确切地说,它可以有四个不同的角色:已知的查询(查询批次中的观察,对应画廊中的某个个人),未知的查询,只有画廊的分心器(对应查询批次中没有的人的观察),和画廊成员(画廊中的观察,也代表了在查询中的个人).
因此,我们进行额外的五倍角色旋转,相当于在验证和测试集中进行额外的身份级别分拆. 同样,这些裂口通过观察计数进行分级。 在每个折叠中,对应给定身份的观测可以对应未知的查询,已知的查询(因此也存在于画廊),也可以对应画廊中的分心器. 在每个折叠中,只有单一观测身份被排除在已知的查询角色之外,留在画廊中作为分心器.

blocks.en: Re-identification metrics are computed on the test set and averaged across the folds.
blocks.zh: 重新识别的度量衡在测试集上计算,并在整个折叠上平均.

blocks.en: 2.5.4 Gallery masking policy for evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.5.4 用于评价的画廊遮盖政策

blocks.en: We consider two evaluation policies: in the first one, we consider a situation where the gallery is composed of all observations from all individuals in the test set, except the unknown-query identities and the observation in the query. We call this setting the "rich gallery" setting. To consider a more challenging scenario where less data are available, we also considered a "sparse gallery" situation where each individual in the gallery only has one observation, by randomly selecting one observation for each individual in the gallery. Under the sparse gallery policy, we repeat the evaluation 5 times for each query, by redrawing selected observations in the gallery uniformly at random among each gallery individual’s observation.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑两项评价政策:在第一项政策中,我们考虑一个情况,即画廊由测试集中所有个人的所有观察组成,除了未知的清静身份和查询中的观察. 我们称之为"丰富的画廊" 为了考虑一个更具有挑战性的情景,在数据较少的情况下,我们也考虑过一个"散地画廊"的情况,即画廊中的每个人只有一次观察,通过随机为画廊中的每个人选择一次观察. 根据人烟稀少的画廊政策,我们重复对每个查询进行5次评价,在画廊中,每个画廊个人的观察中统一随机地重新绘制选定的观察。

blocks.en:
MiewID was trained on a wide diversity of species, but not on seahorses ( Otarashvili et al., 2024 ) . We therefore fine-tuned the pretrained MiewID-msv3 backbone (2152-dimensional embeddings, 440 × 440 440\times 440 input, Otarashvili et al. (2024) ) on our dataset following the method described in Yesharim et al. (2026) , using a sub-center ArcFace head ( Deng et al., 2019 ) with 3 sub-centers, a scale of 64, and a margin of 0.5 rad. We used an identity-disjoint split (70% train / 10% val / 20% test). The backbone’s final layer was frozen, and all BatchNorm modules were kept frozen throughout training. We used the AdamW optimizer with differential learning rates (backbone: 2e-5, ArcFace head: 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4), and a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler over 100 epochs down to a minimum learning rate of 1e-6.
Moreover, we applied data augmentation, including random resized crops (scale 0.75–1.0), color jittering (p=0.8), random grayscale conversion (p=0.2), and Gaussian blur (p=0.5).
We used a batch size of 24, comprising four images from each of six identities.

我们使用了24的批量尺寸,包括六个身份中每个身份的4个图像。

We hypothesized that DINOv3 embeddings contained information regarding the usefulness of a given image for re-identification. Therefore, we trained a logistic regression classifier on a fitting fraction (65% of observations) of the validation split to predict whether image-level closed-set rank-1 re-identification from the fine-tuned MiewID was correct or not, with standardized DINOv3 CLS embeddings as input. We called the output probabilities of this model image relevance scores.
We then weighted the MiewID-derived similarities by the predicted image relevance scores, floored at 0.02 so that no image is discarded, then normalized to sum to 1, and computed the weighted average similarity score.

The second probability in the MAP open-set decision rule, p known p_{\text{known}} , also needs recalibration as it is the result of a logistic regression fitted with balanced known/unknown weights and identity weights. We therefore Platt-recalibrate it against gallery membership.
Note that both recalibrations are monotone and act on scalar scores, so they leave the ranking unchanged.
Compared to the threshold-based open-set decision, this rule requires no decision threshold τ \tau tuned on held-out data: the held-out split is used to calibrate the two inputs instead. The knownness cutoff 1 / ( 1 + s top ) 1/(1+s_{\text{top}}) then moves with the top-candidate confidence, so a query whose top candidate clearly dominates the shortlist is accepted at a lower knownness probability than one whose candidates are tied.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Species and sex classification
blocks.zh: 3.1 物种和性别分类

blocks.en: Individuals contribute very unequal numbers of images and observations, so all reported classification metrics, and the classifier fit itself, are identity-balanced. In order to determine uncertainty related to performance metrics for a fixed trained model, we used percentile bootstrap over individuals with 1,000 draws.
blocks.zh: 个人贡献了非常不平等的图像和观测数量,因此所有报告的分类度量表,以及分类器适合自身,都是身份平衡的. 为了确定一个固定的训练模型的性能指标的不确定性, 我们用百分位的靴子套住1000个抽取物的个人。

blocks.en:
We found that DINOv3 linear probing led to better performance than BioCLIP 2.5 in terms of balanced accuracy and macro F1 (Table 3 ), both at the image level and at the observation level when applying average-logit fusion. Focusing more specifically on DINOv3, we then compared the performance of the different multi-view fusion methods for species classification (Table 4 ) and sex determination (Table 5 ), and found that leveraging all images from an observation led to higher prediction accuracy and better calibration than when considering single images. As expected, since logit sum and logit average do not change the classification decision, they lead to the same balanced accuracy and macro F1. There was no significant difference with majority vote, and all methods leveraging multiple photos resulted in very good classification performance with macro F1 and balanced accuracy above 0.9.
However, when comparing calibration metrics, we found that majority vote was poorly calibrated for species classification compared to average logit or logit sum fusion, which resulted in lower Maximum Calibration Error (MCE), Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier score.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,DINOv3线性检测在平衡准确性和宏F1(表3)方面,无论是在图像层面还是在观测层面,在应用平均logit聚变时,都比BioCLIP 2.5更好的性能. 我们更具体地侧重于DINOv3,然后比较了物种分类(表4)和性别确定(表5)的不同多视图聚变方法的性能,发现利用观测结果的所有图像,比考虑单一图像时,能产生更高的预测准确度和更好的校正. 如所料,由于对数和对数平均值不会改变分类决定,它们导致同样平衡的准确性和宏观F1. 在多数选票上没有显著的区别,所有利用多相相机的方法都产生了非常良好的分类性能,宏观F1,平衡准确度超过0.9.
然而,在比较校正度量表时,我们发现,与平均对数或对数和聚变相比,多数选票对物种分类的校正差,导致最高校正误差、预期校正误差和Brier分数较低。

blocks.en: 3.2 Re-identification
blocks.zh: 3.2 重新确定身份

blocks.en:
Tables 6 and 7 report the re-identification performance in the sparse and rich gallery settings, respectively. We observed that MiewID fine-tuning brought substantial closed-set re-identification improvements. Relevance weighting provided little benefit with one observation per individual in the gallery, but led to substantial improvements in BAUS (and therefore BRA and NA) in the rich gallery setting.
Visual inspection (Figure 2 ) shows that high relevance images are usually side view images of the head with good illumination, whereas low relevance images are whole body images with little detail.
blocks.zh:
表6和表7分别报告了在稀少和丰富的画廊环境中的重新识别表现。 我们注意到,MiewID的微调带来了大量封闭式重新识别改进。 相关权重对画廊中每个人进行一次观察没有多大好处,但使BAUS(因此是BRA和NA)在丰富的画廊环境中有了实质性改善。
视觉检查(图2)显示,高相关性的图像通常为头部有好照度的侧视图图像,而低相关性的图像则为全身图像,几乎没有细节.

blocks.en:
At this stage, we considered that our focus should be on maximizing closed-set accuracy, as we could later improve the knownness detection module. In the case where all observations were included in the gallery except the query, relevance weighting brought improvement in unknown detection, resulting in improved BAUS, BRA and NA.
Reranking a shortlist of candidates using ALIKED/LightGlue provided performance improvements on all performance metrics in the sparse gallery setting, but only improved BAKS in the rich gallery scenario. Adding the logistic knownness detection module then very slightly impacted NA in the sparse gallery setting, but substantially improved all performance metrics in the rich gallery case. This is explained by the much better performance of this model, compared to max-score thresholding, in distinguishing new individuals in the rich gallery case (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh:
在现阶段,我们认为,我们的重点应该是最大限度地提高闭合的精确度,因为我们以后可以改进已知的检测模块。 在除查询外所有观察都包含在画廊中的情况下,相关加权导致未知探测的改进,导致BAUS、BRA和NA的改进。
使用ALIKED/LightGlue重新排列候选人的入围名单,在简陋的画廊布局中对所有的成绩指标提供了业绩改进,但在丰富的画廊情景中只有改进了BAKS. 加上后勤知识探测模块之后,NA在简陋的画廊环境中受到很小的影响,但大大改进了丰富画廊案中的所有性能衡量标准。 其原因是,与最大分数阈值相比,这一模式在区分丰富画廊案中的新个人方面表现要好得多(图3)。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Performance evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 考绩

blocks.en: Due to the significant computational cost of fine-tuning MiewID on our seahorse dataset, we were unable to evaluate how performance varied with changes in the training set. Instead, we focused on estimating the uncertainty associated with the performance of our trained and calibrated system. We note that it is common practice in the re-ID literature not to report uncertainty estimates for test set performance metrics, which unfortunately limits the generalizability of method-comparison results (see, e.g., Cermak et al. (2024) ; Otarashvili et al. (2024) ; Yesharim et al. (2026) ; Adam et al. (2025b) for recent examples).
blocks.zh: 由于在我们的海马数据集上微调MiewID的计算成本很高,我们无法评估业绩如何与培训组合的变化相去甚远。 相反,我们侧重于估计与我们训练有素和校准的系统的业绩有关的不确定性。 我们注意到,重新识别文献中通常的做法是不报告测试成套性能指标的不确定性估计数,这不幸限制了方法比较结果的通用性(例如,见Cermak等人(2024年);Otarashvili等人(2024年);Yesharim等人(2026年);Adam等人(2025年b),最近的例子)。

blocks.en: For a meaningful performance evaluation, the test set should be representative of real-world deployment scenarios. To mimic either the continuation of the re-identification program from which the dataset originated or, by contrast, the deployment of the re-identification system in a new population, we evaluated the re-ID models in rich- and sparse-gallery settings, respectively. Our results show that method performance can vary greatly depending on gallery composition. Note, however, that to fully mimic the conditions of a continuing re-identification program, we could have evaluated performance using the combined training, validation, and test sets. Indeed, in a real-world deployment, it may be possible to train the re-ID model on individuals from the current population, which is expected to substantially improve performance. The reported performance in the rich-gallery setting therefore represents a lower bound on real-world deployment performance.
blocks.zh: 为了进行有意义的业绩评价,这套测试应代表现实世界的部署设想。 为了模仿数据集来源的再识别程序的延续,或者相反地,在新的人群中部署再识别系统,我们分别评价了富人和稀有劳动力环境中的再识别模型. 我们的结果显示,方法的性能会因画廊组成而大相径庭. 然而,请注意,为了完全模仿持续重新识别方案的条件,我们本来可以使用组合培训、验证和测试集来评估业绩。 实际上,在现实世界的部署中,也许可以对目前人口中的个人进行重新识别模式的培训,预计这将大大提高业绩。 因此,所报道的富豪环境业绩对现实世界部署业绩的影响较低。

blocks.en: 4.2 Seahorse re-identification
blocks.zh: 4.2 海马重新识别

blocks.en: In this paper, we demonstrated the feasibility of high-performance automated seahorse taxonomic classification, sex determination and individual re-identification from underwater photograph sequences in the wild. These are especially challenging tasks given that, in these conditions, image quality varies widely, and that European seahorses are cryptic animals with subtle patterns.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们展示了高性能自动海马分类学分类,性别测定和从野外的水下相片序列中单独重新识别的可行性. 这些任务尤其具有挑战性,因为在这种情况下,图像质量差异很大,而欧洲海马是具有微妙规律的隐秘动物.

blocks.en:
We demonstrated that leveraging multiple photographs from underwater observations led to improved performance across these tasks. For re-identification, we extended the WildFusion framework to include evidence from multiple views, and demonstrated that this greatly improves re-identification performance.
Consistent with previous reports ( Yesharim et al., 2026 ) , we found that fine-tuning of a re-identification foundation model led to substantial performance gains. Moreover, we found that applying ALIKED/LightGlue reranking on a set of MiewID-shortlisted gallery observations clearly improved closed-set ranking.
We found that a separate "knownness detection" module used within a Bayes-optimal open-set re-identification rule led to improved open-set performance compared to standard thresholding of the best match score in the case of a rich gallery, where each individual can be represented by many observations.
MiewID fine-tuning was the most important step for performance improvement. While ALIKED/LightGlue reranking improved closed-set performance, it impacted the detection of new individuals not present in the gallery in the rich gallery case. Therefore, in the rich gallery setting, the second best improvement was obtained by using the Bayes-optimal decision rule with an explicit model of the knownness probability.
blocks.zh:
我们证明,利用从水下观测得到的多张照片提高了这些任务的业绩。 对于重新识别,我们扩展了"荒野融合"框架,以包括来自多观点的证据,并表明这极大地改善了重新识别的性能.
与前几次报告(Yesharim等人,2026年)一致,我们发现,对重新确定的基础模式进行微调,取得了实质性的业绩成果。 此外,我们发现,应用ALIKED/LightGlue在一组MiewID短幅画廊观测上重新排位,显然改善了闭合的排名。
我们发现,在Bayes-optimate-opteral open-set再识别规则内使用的一个单独的"已知分量检测"模块,比起一个丰富的画廊中最佳相配分的标准阈值,使得开放相配的性能得到改善,每个个人都可以被许多观察所代表.
微调是改进业绩的最重要步骤。 ALIKED/灯光时 Glue重新排列了改进后的闭合组合表演,影响了在丰富画廊案件中发现没有出现在画廊的新个人。 因此,在丰富的画廊环境中,通过使用具有已知概率的明确模型的贝叶斯-优化决定规则,获得了第二好的改进.

blocks.en: Although a previous preliminary study had reported promising performance in the automatic closed-set re-identification of H. guttulatus from images ( Aloui and Renoult, 2022 ) , it was unclear how computer vision systems would perform in an open-set setting. Moreover, Aloui and Renoult (2022) reported top-1 closed-set accuracy of up to 76% on manually curated data. By contrast, our approach yields better performance on raw data (BAKS of 82% in a similar evaluation setting), although the studies are not directly comparable.
blocks.zh: 虽然前一次初步研究报告了H. gutulatus在图像自动封闭式重新识别(Aloui和Renoult,2022年)方面有希望的表现,但不清楚计算机视觉系统在开放式设置下如何运作。 此外,Aloui和Renoult(2022年)报告说,手动整理的数据的顶级-1闭合精度高达76%。 相比之下,我们的方法在原始数据(在类似评价环境下为82%的BAKS)上表现较好,尽管这些研究没有直接的可比性。

blocks.en: For species classification, given the extreme class imbalance (98% H. guttulatus ), the number of photographs of H. hippocampus was very limited, making it difficult to train a neural network classifier from scratch. In preliminary experiments, we found that a standard approach based on training a convolutional neural network ( Spoto et al., 2024 ) did not work well. By contrast, simply applying a logistic regression classifier on DINOv3 was sufficient to reach very good performance, although more H. hippocampus observations would be needed to better estimate the classification performance. To our knowledge, this is also the first demonstration of the feasibility of using computer vision for seahorse sex determination.
blocks.zh: 在物种分类方面,考虑到极端阶级失衡(98% H. gutulatus),H. hippocampus的照片数量非常有限,因此很难从头开始训练神经网络分类器. 在初步实验中,我们发现,基于培养进化神经网络的标准方法(Spoto等,2024年)效果不佳. 相比之下,仅仅在DINOv3上使用后勤回归分类器就足以达到非常好的性能,尽管更多的 为了更好地估计分类性能,需要H. Hipopampus观测。 据我们所知,这也是利用计算机视觉确定海马性别的可行性的第一次证明。

blocks.en: 4.3 Limitations & future work
blocks.zh: 4.3 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The very small number of H. hippocampus individuals in our dataset prevented us from evaluating the re-identification performance on this species specifically. In future work, we aim to gather more H. hippocampus observation data to provide meaningful performance estimates for each species.
blocks.zh: H. hippocampus在我们的数据集中的人数很少,使我们无法具体评估该物种的重新识别性能。 在今后的工作中,我们的目标是收集更多的H. Hipopampus观测数据,为每个物种提供有意义的性能估计。

blocks.en: Correia et al. (2021) reported that re-identification is more prone to errors for young adults, suggesting that the system’s performance may not be consistent across all age categories in the seahorse population. Our dataset contained a small fraction of re-identified juveniles, making it impractical to precisely estimate re-ID performance across life stages.
blocks.zh: Correia等人(2021年)报告说,对年轻成年人来说,重新识别更容易出错,这表明该系统在海马种群中可能并非所有年龄组的性能一致。 我们的数据集包含一小部分重新鉴定的青少年,因此准确估计整个生命阶段的重新识别性能是不切实际的。

blocks.en: Significant morphological differences exist between populations of the same seahorse species ( Woodall et al., 2017 ; Oruç, 2024 ) . Therefore, it is not clear how well the performance of our trained model will transfer to sites other than the Thau lagoon. It is likely that site-specific fine-tuning may be needed to reach performances similar to those reported in this paper.
blocks.zh: 同一海马物种的种群之间存在显著的形态差异(Woodall等,2017;Oruç,2024.). 因此,不清楚我们训练有素的模型的性能会在多大程度上转移到陶礁湖以外的地点。 可能需要针对具体地点进行微调,以达到本文件所汇报的类似性能。

blocks.en: Our dataset is composed of photographs taken by marine biologists who are expert divers and marine photographers in conditions that are ideal for seahorse re-identification. The photographs were taken at night, using flashes, and in some cases with seahorse manipulation. These conditions may not be as favorable in citizen science projects where recreational divers are involved, and it is not clear at this stage how performance would transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集由海洋生物学家所拍摄的照片组成,他们是专家潜水员和海洋摄影师,在适合海马重新识别的条件下拍摄. 照片是晚上拍摄的,使用闪光灯,有时还使用"海马"操纵. 在涉及娱乐潜水员的公民科学项目中,这些条件可能并不那么有利,目前还不清楚表演会如何转移。

blocks.en: Given that seahorses are mostly sedentary and display strong site fidelity ( Caldwell and Vincent, 2012a ; Boehm et al., 2013 ; Siqueira et al., 2017 ) , photo location and date could be used as additional inputs to the re-identification model, which could improve performance.
blocks.zh: 鉴于海马大多是固定的并表现出强烈的遗址忠诚(Caldwell和Vincent,2012a; Boehm等人,2013年;Siqueira等人,2017年),相片位置和日期可以作为再识别模式的额外投入,这可以提高性能.
